## Yakusuru 1.1, now in nine languages

Yakusuru has always been able to make subtitles in any language. Now the app itself speaks yours too.

The whole interface is available in **English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese and Korean**. That covers every button, menu, hint, warning, the setup wizard, the subtitle editor and the progress messages in the queue. Language names in the pickers follow along, so a Spanish interface lists *Japonés* and a Japanese one lists *日本語*.

### What's new

- **Nine interface languages.** Yakusuru follows your system language automatically. To pick one yourself, open **Settings → Appearance → Interface language** and restart the app.
- **Standard buttons translated too.** OK, Cancel, Next and friends come from Qt's own translations, so dialogs feel native in every language.
- **Layouts that fit.** Longer words in German, French and Russian no longer push text off the edge of the side panel.
- **Easy to add more.** Each language is a single JSON file. The README explains how to add one, and a test makes sure no text is ever left untranslated. Pull requests for new languages are welcome.

The log console stays in English on purpose, so a bug report from anywhere in the world can be read by anyone.

### Upgrading from 1.0

Download **Yakusuru-v1.1.0.zip** below and unzip it over your old folder, or anywhere you like. Your settings, glossary, API keys and downloaded models are kept, since they live outside the app folder. There is nothing new to install.

| System | Open this |
|---|---|
| **macOS** | `macOS/Yakusuru.app` (first time: right-click, **Open**, then **Open** again) |
| **Windows** | `Windows/Yakusuru.exe` (if Windows warns you: **More info**, then **Run anyway**) |
| **Linux** | Run `Linux/install-desktop-entry.sh` once, then start Yakusuru from your applications menu |

### Thanks

Translations were prepared with care, but a native speaker will always catch things we missed. If a word feels off in your language, please [open an issue](https://github.com/SwamiGattasG/yakusuru/issues) or send a pull request.
